signal_generator_session_gate.weekday_restrictions: None (trades Mon-Fri identically; weekend has no ticks)

signal_generator_session_gate.dst_mismatch_finding: Comment assumes London opens 08:00 BST = 07:00 UTC year-round. After UK switches to GMT on 2026-10-25 01:00Z, 07:00-07:59 UTC is pre-London/late Asia, while 16:00-16:30 London local remains inside 16:00 UTC. After US switches to EST on 2026-11-01 06:00Z, NY open moves from 12:00 UTC to 13:00 UTC.

trade_scorer_session_component.dst_mismatch_finding: Awards peak 1.0 overlap score at 12:00-12:59 UTC even after Nov 1 US EST shift when NY is not yet open.
